editorial:
Imagine you are just doing your job at a furniture store when you find a door in the basement that should not be there. That is exactly how things kick off here. You follow a small group of confused workers who step through that door and end up in a giant, endless maze of yellow rooms with humming lights. The vibe is super creepy because everything looks familiar but feels completely wrong. You will feel the tension build up as the characters try to find a way out while realizing they are not alone in this weird place.

The acting feels very real, and the way the movie builds mystery keeps you guessing until the very end. While some parts move a bit slow, the scares are worth it. If you love stories about strange dimensions, you need to see this.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the rooms are actually a glitch in reality. The main character finally finds a door back to the real world, but there is a twist. As he steps through, he realizes he is actually a copy of himself created by the rooms. The real version of him is still trapped inside. He walks back into the furniture store, but he is not the same person who left.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves internet mysteries and strange worlds.
